ValidationRule.description: Next Interaction Date cannot be LESS THAN and EQUAL TO the Last Interaction Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), Next_Interaction_Date__c <= Last_Interaction_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Next Interaction Date must be greater than the Last Interaction Date.
